summary: Cubical Financial Services Ltd board approved allotment of 2.89 crore equity shares at ₹2.50 each. The preferential issue raises ₹7.23 crore from four promoters, including Manoj Agrawal and Kanchan Saraogi.

headline: Sula Vineyards seeks approval for director appointment
summary: Sula Vineyards Limited has issued a postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval for the appointment of Mr. Chaitanya Rathi as a Non-Executive Non-Independent Director. The resolution also covers his annual commission of ₹4 lakh.

headline: Kavveri Defence AGM: FY26 results, AGM date
summary: Kavveri Defence & Wireless Technologies reports a 50.8% drop in consolidated revenue to ₹842.1 million for FY26, with net profit falling 80.7% to ₹124.2 million. The 31st AGM is scheduled for September 30, 2026.

headline: Ecoplast Ltd holds 44th AGM, approves director pay hikes
summary: Ecoplast Limited concluded its 44th Annual General Meeting on September 7, 2026. Shareholders approved the re-appointment of Ravi Amulbhai Mehta and revised remuneration for four directors.

headline: IKIO Technologies to host plant visit on Sep 11
summary: IKIO Technologies Limited has announced a plant visit and investor meet scheduled for September 11, 2026, at its Noida facility. The company stated that discussions will be based solely on public domain information.

headline: Blue Pearl Agriventures FY26 Results & AGM
summary: Blue Pearl Agriventures reported FY26 revenue of ₹500.0 crore and profit of ₹10.3 crore. The company holds an AGM on September 30, 2026, to appoint a new MD and regularize directors.

headline: Panacea Biotec files FY26 BRSR report voluntarily
summary: Panacea Biotec Limited has submitted its Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. The company continues voluntary compliance with SEBI regulations despite falling outside the top 1,000 listed entities by market capitalization.

headline: Shalibhadra Finance launches used commercial vehicle loans
summary: Shalibhadra Finance Limited expands its product portfolio by launching a Used Commercial Vehicle Financing division. The NBFC aims to serve rural logistics with purchase and refinancing options.

headline: TGV Sraac BRSR FY26: Revenue, ESG & Safety
summary: TGV Sraac Ltd reported ₹2,245 crore revenue for FY26 in its BRSR filing. The chemical manufacturer expanded solar capacity to 57.9 MW and maintained zero safety incidents.

headline: Kaka Industries FY26 Results: Profit up 46% to ₹187.7 crore
summary: Kaka Industries reported a 46% rise in net profit to ₹187.7 crore for FY26, driven by 33% revenue growth and margin expansion. The company commissioned its Lasundra plant and a solar facility.

headline: Gulf Oil Lubricants accepts Sandeep Bangia resignation
summary: Gulf Oil Lubricants India Ltd accepted the resignation of Mr. Sandeep Bangia, Head - Strategy, Transformation and E Mobility, effective August 31, 2026. The departure is cited as personal reasons.

headline: Krishna Filament AGM record date set for Sep 23
summary: Krishna Filament Industries has fixed September 23, 2026, as the record date for its 38th Annual General Meeting. The cutoff determines shareholder eligibility to attend and vote.

headline: Last Mile Enterprises schedules 31st AGM for Sept 30
summary: Last Mile Enterprises has announced its 31st AGM for September 30, 2026. The agenda includes adopting FY26 financials, declaring a 2% dividend, and appointing two independent directors.

headline: Allied Digital Services accepts Raghuvir Kamat's resignation
summary: Allied Digital Services Limited has accepted the resignation of Raghuvir Kamat, Assistant Vice President - Projects. His last working day is September 7, 2026.

headline: Usha Martin Education AGM scheduled for Sept 30, 2026
summary: Usha Martin Education & Solutions Limited has scheduled its 29th Annual General Meeting for September 30, 2026. The meeting will be held via Video Conferencing or Other Audio Visual Means.

headline: Meesho to host investor meet on September 10
summary: Meesho Limited has announced an in-person meeting with institutional investors scheduled for September 10, 2026. The event will involve one-on-one and group discussions based on publicly available information.

headline: Avenue Supermarts opens new store in Jaipur
summary: Avenue Supermarts Limited opened a new retail outlet on Tonk Road, Jaipur, on September 7, 2026. The expansion brings the company's total store count to 509 across India.

headline: Gujarat Credit AGM: MD Reappointed, RPT Approved
summary: Gujarat Credit Corporation Ltd schedules its 33rd AGM for September 30, 2026. Key agenda items include the five-year reappointment of Managing Director Amam Shreyans Shah and approval for a related-party lease transaction with Servashanti Properties.

headline: Diffusion Engineers holds investor meet
summary: Diffusion Engineers Limited held a virtual meeting with Bajaj Alternate Investment Management on September 7, 2026, as per SEBI LODR regulations.

headline: Identixweb FY26 Results: Profit up 46% to ₹6.01 crore
summary: Identixweb Limited reported a 46% rise in standalone net profit to ₹6.01 crore for FY26, driven by 30% revenue growth to ₹11.09 crore. The company also listed on the BSE SME platform.

headline: Senthil Infotek files FY26 annual report
summary: Senthil Infotek Limited filed its 32nd annual report for FY26, recording a net profit of ₹0.62 lakh against a loss of ₹212.69 lakh in the prior year. The company also seeks shareholder approval for board appointments and an MOA alteration to include AI and ML services.

headline: Dish TV files FY26 BRSR, discloses regulatory penalties
summary: Dish TV India Limited submitted its Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report for FY26. The filing details governance structures, employee welfare metrics, and regulatory penalties paid during the year.
